messages.subject: Plots of rf LOD vs rf value
parts:
Karl: 

 

I am conducting genotypic error checking in the combined data of four populations; each has about 250 F2 individuals, and in each pop 22 high and 22 lo trait value individuals were selectively genotyped.  Thus, there are 44 x 4 = 176 genotyped individuals and there are 593 SNP markers segregating in the combined data set. 

 

I generated a plot of rf LOD scores versus rf value for all possible marker pairs - see the attached PDF (which includes a zoom-in page).  Most of the outlier marker pairs arise from one (or two) problematic marker(s) that are repeat members of those pairs.  My 1st criterion for an outlier is rf>0.85, so I can easily identify the problem markers by examining the output of this command: print(rf85 <- which(rf[,1:totmar(OBJNAME)]>0.85, arr.in=TRUE))

However, for my second outlier criterion is a rf LOD score GT 4.0).  The problem here, of course, is that there are rf values LT 0.50 and GT 0.5, and I need a listing only of the latter.  Not being well-versed in R, I have tried for some time now to write some R code to do this listing but have failed so far.  To keep me from pulling the last hair  out of my head, would you be able to supply me with some R code to do this?  Many thanks if you can!

 

Jim
